description: Schema used to validate orbital parameters for computation.

units.description: The various units used for the orbital parameters.

time.description: The unit used for time measurements in the orbital parameters.

distance.description: The unit used for distance measurements in the orbital parameters.

angle.description: The unit used for angle measurements in the orbital parameters.

angles.description: The angles used to describe the orbit's offset from its parent plane.

inclination.description: The inclination of the orbit relative to the parent plane.

longitudeOfAscendingNode.description: The longitude of the ascending node of the orbit.

argumentOfPeriapsis.description: The argument of periapsis of the orbit.

epoch.description: The epoch time at which the orbital parameters have been computed.

meanAnomaly.description: The mean anomaly of the orbit at the current epoch.

eccentricity.description: The eccentricity of the orbit, where 0 represents a circular orbit and values closer to 1 represent more elliptical orbits.

semiMajorAxis.description: The semi-major axis of the orbit.

orbitalPeriod.description: The orbital period of the object, in days.
